Aave V3 Audits Repository

Complete list of audits performed on Aave V3 by Trail of Bits, OpenZeppelin, Certora, PeckShield since 2020.

OpenZeppelin: Aave V3 Audit Report

OpenZeppelin completed comprehensive audit of Aave V3 in 2022 covering core lending pool, liquidations, oracle, and governance.

Trail of Bits: Aave V3 Security Review

Trail of Bits audit of Aave V3 protocol, identifying medium-severity issues in liquidation logic, all resolved before mainnet deployment.
